_about: N,N-Dimethylformamide (1) + Isobutanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n,n-dimethylformamide, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n,n-dimethylformamide, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: R. Munoz, J. B. Monton, M. C. Burguet, J. de la Torre, Phase equilibria in the systems isobutyl alcohol +N,N-dimethylformamide, isobutyl acetate +N,N-dimethylformamide and isobutyl alcohol + isobutyl acetate +N,N-dimethylformamide at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 232 (2005) 62-69
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 8, 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0055. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.37 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
